words.enDefinition: dramatic or musical entertainment

examples.en: The school performance sold out the hall, partly thanks to Grandpa's drum solo.
examples.zh: 学校的「演出」门票售罄，多亏了外公的鼓独奏。

examples.en: Their street-corner performance draws a small crowd by the second song.
examples.zh: 他们的街角「表演」到第二首歌就能聚起一小群观众。

words.enDefinition: model considered worthy of imitation

examples.en: Grandma's neat routine became a pattern the younger cousins followed.
examples.zh: 外婆雷打不动的作息成了弟弟妹妹们效仿的「模范」。

examples.en: Her early market trips set a pattern for the whole family.
examples.zh: 她赶早市的习惯为全家人树立了「榜样」。

words.enDefinition: to send something through the air with force, usually with the hand

examples.en: Dad taught me to throw the ball flat so it skids on wet grass.
examples.zh: 爸爸教我平着「扔」球，这样球能在湿草地上滑行。

examples.en: Don't throw the peel into the pond; the ducks already have opinions.
examples.zh: 别把果皮「扔」进池塘，鸭子们已经很有意见了。

words.enDefinition: members of a royal family, or anything belonging to them

examples.en: The royals waved from the balcony during the spring festival visit.
examples.zh: 春节到访时，「王室成员」在阳台上向大家挥手。

examples.en: Crowds lined the square hoping to glimpse the royal family's car.
examples.zh: 人群挤满广场，只为一睹「王室」的车队。

words.enDefinition: derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in

examples.en: We enjoyed the harbour walk so much that we missed the last ferry.
examples.zh: 我们太「享受」海边散步，把末班渡轮都错过了。

examples.en: Grandma enjoys her tea most when the courtyard is quiet.
examples.zh: 院子安静时，外婆「最享受」她的茶了。

words.enDefinition: a person who writes books, articles, or other texts

examples.en: The author signed my aunt's dog-eared copy at the weekend market.
examples.zh: 「作者」在周末市集给姨妈翻卷了边的书签了名。

examples.en: Our favourite author lives two streets away and shops at our market.
examples.zh: 我们最爱的「作家」就住在两条街外，也在我们市场买菜。

words.enDefinition: contemptuous disregard

examples.en: Despite the drizzle, the whole village turned out for the lantern fair.
examples.zh: 「尽管」下着毛毛雨，全村人都来看灯会。

examples.en: The bakery stayed open despite the flood outside its door.
examples.zh: 「尽管」门前发了大水，面包店仍照常营业。

words.enDefinition: the concentration of attention or energy on something

examples.en: The camera's focus stays sharp on the dragon's head, wherever it swings.
examples.zh: 镜头的「焦点」始终锁定舞动的龙头。

examples.en: Grandpa's focus during chess is absolute, even through dinner smells.
examples.zh: 下棋时外公「注意力」高度集中，饭香都干扰不了。

words.enDefinition: the psychological result of perception and learning and reasoning

examples.en: Grandma's knowledge of market prices beats any app in our town.
examples.zh: 外婆对市场行情的「了解」胜过镇上任何应用。

examples.en: His knowledge of every bus route saved our flooded afternoon.
examples.zh: 他熟记公交「路线」，救了我们被雨泡掉的下午。

words.enDefinition: the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped through the body by the heart and contains plasma, blood cells, and platelets

examples.en: Donating blood takes twenty minutes and earns you free biscuits.
examples.zh: 「献血」只要二十分钟，还送饼干。

examples.en: Grandpa's blood pressure drops sharply whenever the mahjong tiles cooperate.
examples.zh: 麻将牌一顺，外公的「血压」就降下来。

words.enDefinition: in the recent past

examples.en: Recently the corner market stall has started taking QR payments.
examples.zh: 「最近」市场摊位开始支持扫码付款了。

examples.en: Grandpa recently learned to video-call and now phones us daily.
examples.zh: 外公「最近」学会了视频通话，现在天天打来。

words.enDefinition: similar things placed in order or happening one after another

examples.en: The whole family watched the documentary series about rivers over dinner.
examples.zh: 全家吃饭时追那部关于河流的「系列」纪录片。

examples.en: A series of delays turned our two-hour trip into five.
examples.zh: 一连「串」延误把两小时的路程拖成了五小时。

words.enDefinition: supply of something available for future use

examples.en: Mum keeps a store of canned peaches for typhoon weeks.
examples.zh: 妈妈存了一批罐头桃子作为「储备」，以备台风周之需。

examples.en: The winter store of pickles lives in Grandma's north-facing cupboard.
examples.zh: 过冬的腌菜「储备」都在外婆朝北的橱柜里。

words.enDefinition: plot of ground where plants are cultivated

examples.en: Grandma's garden feeds the street from June until the first frost.
examples.zh: 外婆的「花园菜园」从六月喂饱整条街，直到初霜。

examples.en: We turned the empty courtyard into a garden of chillies and chrysanthemums.
examples.zh: 我们把空院子改成了种辣椒和菊花的「园子」。

words.enDefinition: the totality of surrounding conditions

examples.en: The market's new glass roof changed the shopping environment completely.
examples.zh: 市场新加的顶棚彻底改变了购物「环境」。

examples.en: Grandma says the village environment kept her knees honest for eighty years.
examples.zh: 外婆说村里的「环境」让她的膝盖健康了八十年。

words.enDefinition: an event that accomplishes its intended purpose

examples.en: The little stall's success rests on Grandma's five a.m. start.
examples.zh: 摊位的「成功」全靠外婆清晨五点开工。

examples.en: Passing the driving test felt like the success of the decade.
examples.zh: 通过驾照考试感觉像是十年一遇的大「成就」。

words.enDefinition: to come or go into

examples.en: Don't enter the storage room; the cat has claimed it.
examples.zh: 别「进」储藏室，猫已经宣布主权了。

examples.en: We entered the temple through the small gate by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们从湖边的小门「进入」寺庙。

words.enDefinition: reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress

examples.en: The bus arrives four minutes late, every single morning, reliably.
examples.zh: 这班公交每天早上都「到」晚四分钟，稳定得可怕。

examples.en: Wait for the rain to arrive before covering the market crates.
examples.zh: 等雨「来了」再盖市场的箱子也不迟。

words.enDefinition: someone regarded as certain to succeed

examples.en: Nobody taught her chess; on the board she is simply a natural.
examples.zh: 没人教过她下棋，她在棋盘上就是「天生的好手」。

examples.en: Grandpa never trained a day, but on the river he's a natural.
examples.zh: 外公一天都没练过，可一到河边就是「天生好手」。

words.enDefinition: the extended spatial location of something

examples.en: The northern region of the island grows the best pears.
examples.zh: 岛上「北部地区」的梨子最好吃。

examples.en: Grandma prefers the quieter region beyond the river for her walks.
examples.zh: 外婆更喜欢河对岸安静些的「区域」，常去散步。

words.enDefinition: message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc

examples.en: The mayor's statement about the flood arrived two days late.
examples.zh: 市长关于洪水的「声明」迟到了两天。

examples.en: Grandpa's statement on the disputed parking spot was completely final.
examples.zh: 外公对争议车位的「表态」一锤定音。

words.enDefinition: important in effect or meaning

examples.en: A significant number of stalls closed after the fire safety check.
examples.zh: 消防安全检查后，「相当多」的摊位关了张。

examples.en: The prize is genuinely significant: one year of free noodles.
examples.zh: 奖品「分量十足」：全年免费面条。

words.enDefinition: an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together

examples.en: The two shops kept a friendly relation for thirty years.
examples.zh: 两家店保持了三十年的友好「关系」。

examples.en: Grandpa studies the close relation between rain and loquat harvests.
examples.zh: 外公研究雨量与枇杷收成之间的「关系」。

words.enDefinition: period of 10 years

examples.en: The bridge has stood for over a decade without one repair request.
examples.zh: 这座桥挺过了十几个「年头」，没有一单维修申请。

examples.en: Within a single decade, the night market doubled in size.
examples.zh: 不出「十年」，夜市的规模翻了一倍。

words.enDefinition: nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication

examples.en: The newspaper article about our lane's garden made Grandma frame it.
examples.zh: 报道我们巷子花园的那篇「文章」，外婆装裱了起来。

examples.en: One article in the magazine lists every dumpling shop by district.
examples.zh: 杂志里有一篇「文章」按区列出了所有饺子店。

words.enDefinition: building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services

examples.en: The harbourside hotel charges extra for rooms facing the sunset.
examples.zh: 海港边的「旅馆」对朝夕阳的房间加收费用。

examples.en: We booked the cheap hotel near the station and heard every train.
examples.zh: 我们订了车站旁的便宜「旅馆」，每班火车都听得真切。

words.enDefinition: in or to a higher place or position

examples.en: The bakery sits above the bicycle shop, and the smell drifts down.
examples.zh: 面包店开在车行「楼上」，香气一路飘下来。

examples.en: Check the luggage rack above your seat before you leave the train.
examples.zh: 下火车前，检查一下座位「上方」的行李架。

words.enDefinition: moving or directed ahead, toward the front

examples.en: Keep your hands forward on the sled if you want to steer.
examples.zh: 想控制方向，滑雪橇时双手要「向前」伸。

examples.en: The crowd pushed forward the moment the temple gates opened.
examples.zh: 庙门一开，人群就「向前」涌去。

words.enDefinition: community of people smaller than a town

examples.en: The village's one bakery closes whenever the baker goes fishing.
examples.zh: 「村里」唯一的面包店在面包师钓鱼时歇业。

examples.en: Grandma's village elects its lantern committee every spring without fail.
examples.zh: 外婆的村庄每年春天选出「村」里的灯会委员会。

words.enDefinition: facility equipped with special equipment and personnel for a particular purpose

examples.en: The station clock is four minutes fast, and everyone knows it.
examples.zh: 「车站」的大钟快四分钟，人尽皆知。

examples.en: Meet me at the station bookshop, the one with the green door.
examples.zh: 在「车站」书店等我，绿门那家。

words.enDefinition: person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination

examples.en: The chalk artist redraws the market square every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 粉笔「画师」每周一早上重画市场广场。

examples.en: Our neighbour, a retired stage artist, judges the lantern contest.
examples.zh: 我们的邻居是退休舞台「美术家」，担任灯会评委。

words.enDefinition: single organism

examples.en: Each individual stallholder decides when to pack up for the rain.
examples.zh: 「每个」摊主自行决定下雨时收不收摊。

examples.en: The discount applies to each individual purchase, not the day's total.
examples.zh: 优惠按每笔单独「消费」计，不看当日总额。

words.enDefinition: the particular occupation for which you are trained

examples.en: Grandpa's fishing career peaked the day he caught two carp.
examples.zh: 外公的钓鱼「生涯」巅峰是钓到两条鲤鱼那天。

examples.en: She changed career from teaching to running the family stall.
examples.zh: 她从教书改「行」，接手了家里的摊位。

words.enDefinition: prominent attribute or aspect of something
acceptedZhAnswers: 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等)

examples.en: The app's best new feature is its offline market map.
examples.zh: 这款应用最大的「特色功能」是离线市场地图。

examples.en: Blue shutters are a common feature of houses in this lane.
examples.zh: 蓝色百叶窗是这条巷子房屋的共同「特征」。

words.enDefinition: formal organization of people or groups of people

examples.en: The neighbourhood association funds all of the street's winter lanterns.
examples.zh: 社区「协会」出资布置街上的冬季灯饰。

examples.en: Our chess association meets above the old teahouse on Thursdays.
examples.zh: 我们的象棋「协会」每周四在老茶馆楼上活动。

words.enDefinition: farther along in space or time or degree

examples.en: The market's influence now reaches far beyond our own district.
examples.zh: 这个市场的影响超出了我们「本区」。

examples.en: The queue had stretched beyond the fountain by nine sharp.
examples.zh: 九点整，队伍已经排到了喷泉「之外」。

words.enDefinition: enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure

examples.en: Grandma is happiest, and loudest, at the crowded fish market.
examples.zh: 外婆在水产市场最「开心」，嗓门也最大。

examples.en: The happy crowd stayed outside until the lanterns went dark.
examples.zh: 「高高兴兴的」人群待到灯笼熄灭才散。

words.enDefinition: shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage

examples.en: Grandpa built the fence to protect the seedlings from the market cats.
examples.zh: 外公扎起篱笆「保护」菜苗，防的是市场的猫。

examples.en: Wear the hood up; it protects your ears from the river wind.
examples.zh: 把帽子戴上，可以「护住」耳朵，挡挡河风。

words.enDefinition: be in charge of, act on, or dispose of

examples.en: Grandma manages the family accounts with one notebook and no mercy.
examples.zh: 外婆用一个本子「管」全家的账，铁面无私。

examples.en: He somehow manages both the night stall and the morning one.
examples.zh: 他不知怎么竟能同时「打理」夜摊和早摊。

words.enDefinition: to influence someone or something; to produce a change in

examples.en: The festival dates affect every bus timetable in the county.
examples.zh: 节庆日期会「影响」全县的公交时刻表。

examples.en: Don't let one burnt batch affect your confidence in the wok.
examples.zh: 别让一批炒糊的货「动摇」你对自己的炒锅的信心。

words.enDefinition: recognize as being; establish the identity of someone or something

examples.en: I couldn't identify the caller because Grandma answers as the shop.
examples.zh: 我认不出「来电者是谁」，因为外婆接电话总报店名。

examples.en: The vet identified the cat's breed from one ear and much attitude.
examples.zh: 兽医凭一只耳朵和十足的气势，「鉴定」出了这只猫的品种。

words.enDefinition: means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information

examples.en: The local media arrived before the brass band finished tuning.
examples.zh: 「媒体」在铜管乐队调完音之前就到了。

examples.en: Grandma blames the media for every price rise at the market.
examples.zh: 外婆把市场上每次涨价都归咎于「媒体」。

words.enDefinition: poised for action

examples.en: By seven, the whole stall was ready for the morning crowd.
examples.zh: 七点整，摊位已经「准备就绪」，迎接早市人潮。

examples.en: The dumplings were ready the moment the last guest arrived.
examples.zh: 最后一位客人一到，饺子恰好「做好」了。

words.enDefinition: used in a request to make it more polite

examples.en: Please pass the soy sauce; the dumplings are getting impatient.
examples.zh: 「请」把酱油递过来，饺子等不及了。

examples.en: Please water the balcony plants while I'm at the market.
examples.zh: 我去市场期间，「请」给阳台的花浇水。

words.enDefinition: one or some or every or all without specification

examples.en: Whatever the weather says, Grandma takes her umbrella to market.
examples.zh: 「不管」天气预报怎么说，外婆赶集都带伞。

examples.en: Whatever stall you pick, they all sell her famous loquats.
examples.zh: 「无论哪个」摊位都行，都卖她的枇杷。

words.enDefinition: factor causing trouble in achieving a positive result or tending to produce a negative result

examples.en: The only difficulty with the stall is the three a.m. alarm.
examples.zh: 这个摊位唯一的「难处」是凌晨三点起床。

examples.en: Grandpa overcame his difficulty with smartphones by labelling every icon.
examples.zh: 外公给每个图标贴上标签，克服了用智能机的「困难」。

words.enDefinition: any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks

examples.en: The juicing machine at the market eats coins and oranges equally.
examples.zh: 市场里的榨汁「机」吞起硬币和橙子一样麻利。

examples.en: Grandpa's old sewing machine predates three of our county mayors.
examples.zh: 外公的缝纫「机」比我们三任镇长岁数都大。

words.enDefinition: contemporary person

examples.en: Unlike the moderns, Grandpa still keeps accounts in a paper ledger.
examples.zh: 和「现代人」不同，外公仍用纸质账本记账。

examples.en: The moderns queue for bubble tea; Grandma queues for the fish stall.
examples.zh: 「现代人」排队买奶茶，外婆排队买鱼。

words.enDefinition: available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed

examples.en: Grandma treats the pantry as a resource to be defended.
examples.zh: 外婆把储藏室当作要捍卫的「资源」。

examples.en: The library's free tutoring is the whole neighbourhood's best resource.
examples.zh: 图书馆的免费辅导是社区最好的「资源」。

words.enDefinition: (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level

examples.en: The loquat trees showed new growth after the spring rain.
examples.zh: 春雨过后，枇杷树冒出了新「枝芽」。

examples.en: Grandma measures the puppy's growth against the kitchen door frame.
examples.zh: 外婆用厨房门框量小狗的「生长」。

words.enDefinition: establish after a calculation, investigation, experiment, survey, or study

examples.en: The scale outside the clinic will determine your parking fate.
examples.zh: 诊所门口的地秤将「决定」你的停车命运。

examples.en: One taste will determine whether we order the whole crate.
examples.zh: 尝一口就能「确定」要不要订整箱。

words.enDefinition: to prepare verbally, either for written or spoken delivery

examples.en: Grandma prepares the dumpling filling the night before the festival.
examples.zh: 节前一天，外婆就开始「调制」饺子馅。

examples.en: Prepare your speech for the lantern fair; the microphone is old.
examples.zh: 灯会上的发言「准备好」，话筒很旧。

words.enDefinition: to identify someone or something because you have encountered them before

examples.en: Grandpa can recognize the delivery rider by bell sound alone.
examples.zh: 外公光凭铃声就能「认出」那个快递骑手。

examples.en: I recognized the song before the stall's radio finished the intro.
examples.zh: 摊位收音机前奏还没放完，我就「听出」了这首歌。

words.enDefinition: (mathematics) a mathematical relation such that each element of a given set (the domain of the function) is associated with an element of another set (the range of the function)

examples.en: The spreadsheet's SUM function saved our market accounts in minutes.
examples.zh: 表格的求和「函数」几分钟就理清了我们的账目。

examples.en: Graph the function first; the shape tells you the answer.
examples.zh: 先把「函数」图像画出来，形状会告诉你答案。

words.enDefinition: (United Kingdom) a region created by territorial division for the purpose of local government

examples.en: Our county's produce fair fills the town oval every autumn.
examples.zh: 我们「县」的农产品展销会每年秋天填满整个椭圆广场。

examples.en: The county council finally fixed the whole market's leaking roof.
examples.zh: 「县」议会终于修好了市场漏雨的顶棚。

words.enDefinition: the inherent complex of attributes that determines a persons moral and ethical actions and reactions

examples.en: Grandma judges a person's character by how they treat stallholders.
examples.zh: 外婆看「人品」，只看人怎么对待摊贩。

examples.en: The cartoon character on the dumpling shop sign winks at buses.
examples.zh: 饺子店招牌上的卡通「人物」会朝公交车眨眼。

words.enDefinition: the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances

examples.en: The parrot's behaviour changes completely around dinner time each day.
examples.zh: 晚饭时分，鹦鹉的「行为」会完全变样。

examples.en: Grandpa's parking behaviour improved greatly after the second wheel clamp.
examples.zh: 被锁第二次轮子后，外公的停车「表现」变好了。

words.enDefinition: particular kind (as to appearance)

examples.en: The shop's style mixes old market scales with modern shelves.
examples.zh: 这家店的「风格」把老式市场秤和新式货架混在一起。

examples.en: Grandma's scarf style hasn't changed at all since the eighties.
examples.zh: 外婆围「丝巾」的样式从八十年代就没变过。

words.enDefinition: the feeling aroused by something strange and surprising

examples.en: The kids stared at the volcano exhibit in open wonder.
examples.zh: 孩子们睁大眼睛，「惊叹地」看着火山展品。

examples.en: Grandpa watched the eclipse with quiet wonder and one shared lens.
examples.zh: 外公共用一片镜片，「惊叹地」看完了日食。

words.enDefinition: broadcasting visual images of stationary or moving objects

examples.en: Grandpa's television shows the weather, the opera, and nothing else.
examples.zh: 外公的「电视」只播天气预报和戏曲，别的频道不装。

examples.en: We watched the temple fair on television because of the rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们只好在「电视」上看庙会。

words.enDefinition: pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing

examples.en: The embroidery is pretty enough to hang in the window year-round.
examples.zh: 这刺绣「漂亮」得可以常年挂在橱窗里。

examples.en: Grandma calls the new market roof very pretty and overpriced.
examples.zh: 外婆说市场的新顶棚「好看」是好看，就是贵了。

words.enDefinition: involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit

examples.en: Grandpa's physical check-up always takes longer than the doctor's lunch.
examples.zh: 外公的「体格检查」比医生的午餐时间还长。

examples.en: The physical work of unloading crates kept the winter weight off.
examples.zh: 卸货这种「体力活」让他冬天也没长胖。

words.enDefinition: solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times

examples.en: The shopkeeper's old horse once delivered our flour before dawn.
examples.zh: 店主的「马」曾在天亮前送来面粉。

examples.en: Grandpa feeds the field horse a carrot every market day.
examples.zh: 每个赶集日，外公都要喂拉车的「马」一根胡萝卜。

words.enDefinition: communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled

examples.en: Grandma left a message with the neighbour about the missing crate.
examples.zh: 外婆托邻居「捎话」，说少了一个货箱。

examples.en: The answering machine holds exactly one message: Grandpa singing badly.
examples.zh: 答录机里存着一条「留言」：外公在唱歌。

words.enDefinition: the usual or expected state; as normal

examples.en: Life in the lane returned to normal the day the market reopened.
examples.zh: 市场重新开张那天，巷子里的生活恢复了「正常」。

examples.en: Grandpa insists that talking to his plants is perfectly normal.
examples.zh: 外公坚称跟植物说话完全「正常」。

words.enDefinition: dismiss from the mind; stop remembering

examples.en: I always forget the market list, so Grandma pins it to my sleeve.
examples.zh: 我总「忘」带购物清单，外婆干脆把它别在我袖子上。

examples.en: Grandpa forgets where he parked the cart but never the route home.
examples.zh: 外公总「忘记」推车停哪了，却从不忘回家的路。

words.enDefinition: brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure

examples.en: Sort the glass bottles separately; the truck comes on Fridays.
examples.zh: 「玻璃」瓶要分类放，收运车周五来。

examples.en: Grandma recycles every jam jar of glass, with no exceptions.
examples.zh: 外婆连果酱瓶的「玻璃」都要回收，从不例外。

words.enDefinition: undergo or be subjected to

examples.en: The peach trees suffered after the late frost took the blossoms.
examples.zh: 晚霜打落花后，桃树「受损」不小。

examples.en: Grandpa's pride suffered when the cat caught the biggest carp.
examples.zh: 被猫抢先抓到大鲤鱼，外公的「自尊心」受了伤。

words.enDefinition: just preceding something else in time or order

examples.en: The previous stallholder left us the recipe and one rusty scale.
examples.zh: 「前任」摊主给我们留下了配方和一杆生锈的秤。

examples.en: Grandma still compares every price to last year's previous numbers.
examples.zh: 外婆拿每个价格和去年的「旧」数比。

words.enDefinition: someone who is a member of the faculty at a college or university

examples.en: The retired chemistry professor shops at our stall every Thursday.
examples.zh: 那位化学「教授」每周四都来我们的摊位买菜。

examples.en: Grandpa argues chess with the retired professor by the fountain.
examples.zh: 外公常和喷泉边退休的「教授」下棋抬杠。

words.enDefinition: prepare and issue for public distribution or sale

examples.en: The university press published Grandma's pickle research twice last year.
examples.zh: 大学「出版社」把外婆的腌菜研究出版了两回。

examples.en: Our little lane newsletter publishes Grandpa's weather rhymes every month.
examples.zh: 巷子通讯刊每月「刊载」外公的天气谚语。

words.enDefinition: (criminal law) an act punishable by law; usually considered an evil act

examples.en: The stolen scooter was crime enough for our quiet street.
examples.zh: 被盗的小电驴成了我们安静街道上最大的一桩「罪案」。

examples.en: Grandpa says littering is the only crime our lane knows.
examples.zh: 外婆说乱扔垃圾是本巷唯一的「违法行为」。

words.enDefinition: fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true

examples.en: Her strongest argument for the market roof was the wet receipts.
examples.zh: 支持加盖顶棚最有力的「论据」是那些湿掉的收据。

examples.en: Grandpa's whole argument rests on thirty years of price notebooks.
examples.zh: 外公的「论证」靠的是三十年的价格笔记本。

words.enDefinition: in any case; used to continue, dismiss a detail, or return to the main point

examples.en: The stall sold out anyway, despite my pessimistic weather reading.
examples.zh: 「不管怎样」，尽管我不看好天气，货还是卖光了。

examples.en: We missed the ferry anyway, so we ate dumplings by the pier.
examples.zh: 渡轮「反正」没赶上，我们就在码头边吃起了饺子。

words.enDefinition: stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something

examples.en: Grandpa avoids the ring road between five and seven, religiously.
examples.zh: 外公雷打不动，五点到七点「避开」环城路。

examples.en: The cat still avoids our stall since the water-squirting incident.
examples.zh: 自从那次喷水事件，那只猫就「躲着」我们的摊位了。

words.enDefinition: mail that is distributed by a rapid and efficient system

examples.en: Send the contract by express; the fax died in the storm.
examples.zh: 合同用「快递」寄，传真机在暴雨里坏了。

examples.en: The express parcel arrived smelling faintly of the sorting office.
examples.zh: 「快递」包裹到了，隐约带着分拣中心的气味。

words.enDefinition: express a supposition

examples.en: Suppose the market opens late; we can sort the crates first.
examples.zh: 「假设」市场晚开门，我们可以先分拣货箱。

examples.en: Let's suppose the ferry is full and pack extra snacks.
examples.zh: 「假定」渡轮满员，那我们多备些零食。

words.enDefinition: the place designated as the end (as of a race or journey)

examples.en: Grandpa collapsed triumphantly at the finish of the fun run.
examples.zh: 外公在趣味长跑的「终点」意气风发地瘫坐下来。

examples.en: The finish line taped across the lane is purely symbolic.
examples.zh: 横跨巷子的「终点」胶带纯属象征意义。

words.enDefinition: the most favorable environment for a plant or animal

examples.en: Behind a wok of boiling oil, Uncle Wei is in his element.
examples.zh: 站在翻滚的油锅前，伟叔完全回到了自己的「本行」。

examples.en: Grandma is in her element sorting beans and gossiping simultaneously.
examples.zh: 外婆一边分豆子一边聊八卦，正是她「最自在的环境」。

words.enDefinition: fact that has been verified

examples.en: Grandpa checks the truth of weather rumours against the almanac.
examples.zh: 外公对照历书核实天气传言的「真相」。

examples.en: The truth about the missing melon surfaced in the cat's bed.
examples.zh: 失踪甜瓜的「真相」在猫窝里水落石出。

words.enDefinition: happening unexpectedly

examples.en: Suddenly the whole market smelled of grilled squid and wet umbrellas.
examples.zh: 市场上「突然」弥漫起烤鱿鱼和湿雨伞的气味。

examples.en: The lights went out suddenly, and the mahjong table kept playing by phone torch.
examples.zh: 灯「忽然」灭了，麻将桌就着手机手电接着打。

words.enDefinition: written order directing a bank to pay money

examples.en: The landlord accepts cash, transfer, or a check with two signatures.
examples.zh: 房东收现金、转账，或者一张带两个签名的「支票」。

examples.en: Grandpa writes the rent check in green ink, every single month.
examples.zh: 外公每月都用绿墨水签房租「支票」。

words.enDefinition: the name given to a book, film, or work; a word describing a person’s job or rank

examples.en: The book's title promises dumplings and delivers a detective story.
examples.zh: 这本书的「标题」承诺了饺子，讲的却是侦探故事。

examples.en: Her job title grew longer the smaller the office became.
examples.zh: 办公室越小，她的「头衔」反而越长。

words.enDefinition: an occurrence that causes special pleasure or delight

examples.en: Fresh loquats in winter are a real treat at our table.
examples.zh: 冬天能吃上鲜枇杷，对我们家是真正的「乐事」。

examples.en: Grandma treats the visiting cousins to her fried dough sticks.
examples.zh: 外婆用自炸油条「款待」来访的表亲们。

words.enDefinition: from first to last

examples.en: The museum somehow stays calm throughout the entire school holidays.
examples.zh: 不知怎的，博物馆在长假期间「自始至终」都很安静。

examples.en: Bunting hangs throughout the lane from New Year to Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 从新年到元宵，彩旗「遍及」整条巷子。

words.enDefinition: an extended communication (often interactive) dealing with some particular topic

examples.en: The discussion over the market roof lasted three dumplings each.
examples.zh: 关于市场顶棚的「讨论」，每人吃掉三个饺子才结束。

examples.en: After the discussion, we voted; after the vote, we ate.
examples.zh: 「讨论」完我们表决，表决完就开吃。

words.enDefinition: without distinction of one from others

examples.en: Grandpa generally wins the chess table by refusing to hurry.
examples.zh: 外公下棋从不着急，所以「一般」都能赢。

examples.en: The stall is generally quiet until the school bell rings.
examples.zh: 放学铃响之前，摊位「通常」都很清净。

words.enDefinition: message expressing an opinion based on incomplete evidence

examples.en: My guess is the ferry leaves at four, but check the board.
examples.zh: 我「猜」渡轮四点开，不过还是看下时刻牌吧。

examples.en: Grandma's guess about the weather is right nine times in ten.
examples.zh: 外婆对天气的「猜测」十有九中。

words.enDefinition: person responsible for the administration of a business

examples.en: The marketing executive drinks the same stall tea as the porters.
examples.zh: 那位市场部「主管」和搬运工喝同一家摊位的茶。

examples.en: Our co-op elected a new executive at the spring meeting.
examples.zh: 春季大会上，合作社选出了一位新「主管」。

words.enDefinition: of or relating to or resulting from industry

examples.en: The industrial estate beyond the river hums at four each morning.
examples.zh: 河对岸的「工业区」每天凌晨四点就开始轰鸣。

examples.en: Grandpa's old factory neckties date from the industrial boom years.
examples.zh: 外公的旧厂领带是「工业」繁荣年代的产物。

words.enDefinition: to take something away from the place where it was

examples.en: Remove the scale from the counter before the health inspector smiles.
examples.zh: 卫生检查员来之前，把秤从柜台上「挪开」。

examples.en: Grandpa removed the splinter with tweezers and absolutely zero sympathy.
examples.zh: 外公「取出」了扎的刺，用的镊子，外加零点同情。

words.enDefinition: whole or complete, with no part left out

examples.en: The entire courtyard smelled of strong vinegar and boiled chives.
examples.zh: 「整个」院子都是醋味和煮韭菜的味道。

examples.en: Grandma invited the entire lane over to the loquat tasting.
examples.zh: 外婆请了「全巷子」的人来品枇杷。

words.enDefinition: feeling regret or sorrow; pitiable, in poor condition

examples.en: I'm sorry about the broken teacup; I'll glue it tonight.
examples.zh: 茶杯打碎了我很「抱歉」，今晚就粘上。

examples.en: Grandma felt sorry for the rain-soaked busker and bought two tapes.
examples.zh: 外婆「替…难过」，同情淋雨的街头艺人，买了两盘磁带。

words.enDefinition: have an existence, be extant

examples.en: The chess club exists because Grandpa refused to let it fold.
examples.zh: 象棋社能「存在」，全靠外公拒绝让它解散。

examples.en: Grandma insists a tidy stall and a happy cat cannot both exist.
examples.zh: 外婆坚称摊位整洁和猫开心没法同时「存在」。

words.enDefinition: large natural stream of water (larger than a creek)

examples.en: The river floods the low stalls every spring, right on schedule.
examples.zh: 每年春天，「河水」都会准时漫上低处的摊位。

examples.en: Grandpa fishes the river before dawn and sells by seven.
examples.zh: 外公天亮前在「河」边垂钓，七点前就开卖。

words.enDefinition: inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to

examples.en: Grandpa encouraged my chess habit with a pocket set and zero advice.
examples.zh: 外公送我一套口袋棋，不「指导」一步，默默鼓励我下棋。

examples.en: The vendor encouraged us to taste the pickles before buying.
examples.zh: 摊主「怂恿」我们先尝后买。

words.enDefinition: medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease

examples.en: Quinine was once the specific treatment for the marsh fevers.
examples.zh: 奎宁曾是治疗沼泽热病的「特效药」。

examples.en: The chemist kept one specific for the summer rashes behind the counter.
examples.zh: 药剂师在柜台后备着治夏日皮疹的「特效药」。

words.enDefinition: an interconnected system of things or people

examples.en: Grandpa's radio picks up the fishing network on clear nights.
examples.zh: 晴天夜里，外公的收音机能收到渔业「电台网络」。

examples.en: The market's weak Wi-Fi network somehow covers exactly one bench.
examples.zh: 市场的无线「网络」只覆盖一张长椅。

words.enDefinition: relating to religion or faith

examples.en: The temple fair has religious roots and truly excellent noodles.
examples.zh: 庙会有「宗教」渊源，面也做得极好。

examples.en: Morning chanting is the only religious practice that Grandpa keeps.
examples.zh: 晨诵是外公唯一保留的「宗教」仪式。

words.enDefinition: manifest or bring back

examples.en: The pond reflects the lanterns so precisely that fish seem to fly.
examples.zh: 池塘「倒映」着灯笼，鱼儿像在飞。

examples.en: The mirror reflects the stall's red banner across the lane.
examples.zh: 镜子把摊位的红旗「反射」到了巷子对面。

words.enDefinition: take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof

examples.en: I assumed the stall closed at six; it closes at five.
examples.zh: 我「以为」摊位六点关门，其实五点就收了。

examples.en: Grandpa assumed responsibility for the cat the day it arrived.
examples.zh: 猫来的那天，外公就「承担」起了照顾它的责任。

words.enDefinition: declare to be true or admit the existence or reality or truth of

examples.en: Grandpa finally admitted the cat outranks him at the stall.
examples.zh: 外公终于「承认」猫在摊位的地位比他高。

examples.en: The mayor admitted the parking scheme needed one more sign.
examples.zh: 镇长「承认」停车方案还差一块指示牌。

words.enDefinition: building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose

examples.en: The lane's walls are stone, cold in June and cool in August.
examples.zh: 巷子的墙是「石头」砌的，六月透凉，八月阴凉。

examples.en: Grandpa's paperweight is a river stone shaped like a dumpling.
examples.zh: 外公的镇纸是一块形似饺子的河「石」。

words.enDefinition: any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal

examples.en: The council's first measure against flooding was one sandbag and a prayer.
examples.zh: 议会防洪的第一项「措施」是一只沙袋加一次祈祷。

examples.en: Safety measures at the fryer include shoes, and always shoes.
examples.zh: 油炸锅旁的安全「措施」包括穿鞋——必须穿鞋。

words.enDefinition: an army unit large enough to sustain combat

examples.en: Grandpa served in an armoured division and drove the cook truck.
examples.zh: 外公在装甲「师」服役，开的是炊事车。

examples.en: The old division's veterans meet every spring by the river.
examples.zh: 老部「队」的老兵们每年春天在河边聚一次。

words.enDefinition: something that is remembered

examples.en: The smell of fried dough is my strongest market memory.
examples.zh: 炸油条的香味是我最深的集市「记忆」。

examples.en: Grandpa's memory for prices embarrasses every calculator in the lane.
examples.zh: 外公对价格的「记性」让全巷的计算器都自愧不如。

words.enDefinition: facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement

examples.en: The baby's first smile was aimed at the market cat.
examples.zh: 宝宝的第一个「微笑」送给了市场那只猫。

examples.en: Grandma's wide smile reappears whenever anyone mentions the loquat season.
examples.zh: 一提枇杷季，外婆的「笑容」就回来了。

words.enDefinition: substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)

examples.en: Grandpa quietly replaced the wobbly stool before anyone else noticed.
examples.zh: 趁别人还没发现，外公把晃悠的凳子「换」掉了。

examples.en: The stall's old scale was replaced by a digital one with a voice.
examples.zh: 摊位的旧秤换成了会报数的电子「秤」。

words.enDefinition: trying something to find out about it

examples.en: The clinic's sleep trial needed ten volunteers and one quiet room.
examples.zh: 诊所的睡眠「试验」要十名志愿者和一间安静的屋子。

examples.en: Our free trial of the new delivery app expired mid-order.
examples.zh: 送餐应用的免费「试用」在下单中途到期了。

words.enDefinition: person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully

examples.en: Grandpa is officially the lane's expert on forgotten umbrella retrieval.
examples.zh: 外公是本巷找回遗忘雨伞的「专家」。

examples.en: Every market has one pickle expert, and ours is Grandma.
examples.zh: 每个市场都有一位腌菜「行家」，我们的就是外婆。

words.enDefinition: the season of growth

examples.en: The spring rain arrived the day we finally mended the awning.
examples.zh: 我们刚补好雨棚，「春天」的雨就来了。

examples.en: Grandma airs the quilts on the first warm spring afternoon.
examples.zh: 「春」天头一个暖和的下午，外婆就晒被子。

words.enDefinition: except if; except under the condition that

examples.en: The stall always stays open unless the rain gets sideways.
examples.zh: 「除非」雨大得横着下，摊位都会照常开。

examples.en: The stall stays calm unless the cat finds the scale.
examples.zh: 摊位一直很太平，「除非」那只猫发现了秤。

words.enDefinition: remark that calls attention to something or someone

examples.en: Grandpa never fails to mention the year it snowed in April.
examples.zh: 外公总要「提」四月下雪那一年。

examples.en: The article even mentions our lane's dumpling stall by name.
examples.zh: 那篇文章点名「提到」了我们巷子的饺子摊。

words.enDefinition: to make better

examples.en: Grandma improved the pickle recipe by adding one Sichuan peppercorn.
examples.zh: 外婆往腌菜里加了一粒花椒，配方就此「改良」。

examples.en: My chess improved the day Grandpa stopped letting me win.
examples.zh: 外公不再让我赢棋那天，我的棋艺「进步」了。

words.enDefinition: unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')

examples.en: Obviously the cat opened the flour bag; the paw prints agree.
examples.zh: 「显然」是猫打开了面粉袋，爪印也作证。

examples.en: Grandpa said, obviously the ferry is late, while it left early.
examples.zh: 渡轮明明提前开了，外公还说「显然」会晚点。

words.enDefinition: form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case

examples.en: Close your eyes and imagine the market without the smell of fish.
examples.zh: 闭上眼，「想象」一下没有鱼腥味的市场。

examples.en: Grandpa can imagine a rain delay from one dark cloud.
examples.zh: 外公看一片乌云就能「预想」出一场雨。

words.enDefinition: plane figure bounded by two radii and the included arc of a circle

examples.en: The geometry homework asks us to shade one sector of the circle.
examples.zh: 几何作业要我们给圆的一个「扇形」涂色。

examples.en: Grandpa cut the melon into six equal sectors, one per cousin.
examples.zh: 外公把甜瓜切成六个均等的「扇块」，每个表亲一块。

words.enDefinition: the present or immediately coming night

examples.en: The grand lantern judging happens tonight, rain or dancing lions.
examples.zh: 灯会评选「今晚」举行，下雨舞狮都不改。

examples.en: Grandpa promises a story tonight if the dishes are washed.
examples.zh: 碗洗了，外公「今晚」就讲故事。

words.enDefinition: line leading to a place or point

examples.en: The lost crow flew in the right direction and found the market anyway.
examples.zh: 迷路的乌鸦「方向」倒是没错，最后还是找到了市场。

examples.en: Grandpa always gives directions in dumpling shops, not street names.
examples.zh: 外公指「方向」从来报饺子铺，不报街名。

words.enDefinition: forming an essential foundation; fundamental or simple

examples.en: The stall's rules are basic: pay first, taste freely, queue kindly.
examples.zh: 摊位规矩很「基本」：先付款，随便尝，好好排队。

examples.en: Grandma says basic courtesy is what keeps the market calm.
examples.zh: 外婆说「基本的」礼貌能让市场太平。

words.enDefinition: the reflexive or emphatic form of you, used when the subject and object are the same person, or for emphasis

examples.en: You can open the stall yourself once the register balances.
examples.zh: 收银台对上账后，你就可以「自己」开摊了。

examples.en: The spare key is under the mat; let yourself in.
examples.zh: 钥匙在垫子下面，「你自己」开门进来。

words.enDefinition: have in mind as a purpose

examples.en: I intend to arrive before the good pears are picked over.
examples.zh: 我「打算」趁好梨还没被挑走之前赶到。

examples.en: Grandpa intends to retire every winter and never once has.
examples.zh: 外公每年冬天都「打算」退休，可一次也没退成。

words.enDefinition: existing from the beginning; not a copy or imitation

examples.en: The stall's original sign now hangs framed above the till.
examples.zh: 摊位的「最初的」招牌现在裱起来挂在收银台上方。

examples.en: Her original plan was one week; the loquats kept her a month.
examples.zh: 她的「原本」计划是待一周，枇杷让她多留了一个月。

words.enDefinition: the striking of one body against another

examples.en: The hail's impact dented every awning along the market street.
examples.zh: 冰雹的「冲击」砸凹了市场街沿途所有的雨棚。

examples.en: Grandpa studied the impact of the price rise on queue length.
examples.zh: 外公研究涨价对排队长度产生的「影响」。

words.enDefinition: respond favorably or as hoped

examples.en: Her knee responded well to the warm compress and stubborn rest.
examples.zh: 热敷加坚决休息，她的膝盖「见效」很快。

examples.en: The new pickles responded to the cooler shelf within two days.
examples.zh: 换了阴凉货架后，新腌菜两天就「反应良好」。

words.enDefinition: (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception

examples.en: I wasn't aware the market closed early on public holidays.
examples.zh: 我没有「意识到」市场在节假日会提早关门。

examples.en: Grandpa was aware of the price rise before any notice appeared.
examples.zh: 告示还没贴出来，外公就「发觉」涨价了。

words.enDefinition: make a discovery, make a new finding

examples.en: We discovered the best dumpling stall behind the temple wall.
examples.zh: 我们在庙墙后「发现」了最好的饺子摊。

examples.en: Grandpa discovered the cat can open the pickle jar, upside down.
examples.zh: 外公「发现」那猫能倒着拧开腌菜罐。

words.enDefinition: disclose directly or through prophets

examples.en: The X-ray revealed a hairline crack in the teapot lid.
examples.zh: X光「揭示」出茶壶盖上有一道细纹。

examples.en: Grandpa revealed the pickle recipe only after the third pot of tea.
examples.zh: 喝到第三壶茶，外公才「透露」腌菜配方。

words.enDefinition: any instrument or instrumentality used in fighting or hunting

examples.en: The only weapon at the food fight was a spoonful of pudding.
examples.zh: 这场食物大战唯一的「武器」是一勺布丁。

examples.en: Grandpa calls his rolling pin the family's most feared weapon.
examples.zh: 外公管他的擀面杖叫全家最令人敬畏的「武器」。

words.enDefinition: show unwillingness towards

examples.en: Grandpa flatly refuses to sell the last loquats before noon.
examples.zh: 中午之前，外公「拒绝」卖掉最后一批枇杷。

examples.en: The cat refuses to move from the warm delivery box.
examples.zh: 猫「拒绝」从暖和的快递箱里挪窝。

words.enDefinition: keep from happening or arising; make impossible

examples.en: The netting prevents the sparrows from taxing our cherry crop.
examples.zh: 防护网「防止」麻雀向我们征收樱桃税。

examples.en: Grandpa insists a hot breakfast prevents every winter market cold.
examples.zh: 外公说热乎的早餐能「预防」逛集市着凉。

words.enDefinition: an event or set of related events; a matter of public or private concern

examples.en: The temple fair is the social affair of our spring.
examples.zh: 庙会是今春我们这里的一件社交「大事」。

examples.en: Grandpa personally handles foreign affairs with the visiting tea merchants.
examples.zh: 来访的茶商，由外公负责「对外交涉」。

words.enDefinition: attractiveness that interests or pleases or stimulates

examples.en: The night market's appeal is equal parts noodles and gossip.
examples.zh: 夜市的「吸引力」一半靠面，一半靠八卦。

examples.en: Grandma doubts the new mall will have much appeal for her.
examples.zh: 外婆怀疑新商场对她的「吸引力」有限。

words.enDefinition: an act of shaking; a quick back-and-forth movement

examples.en: Give the paint tin a firm shake before you open it.
examples.zh: 开罐前把油漆桶用力「摇一摇」。

examples.en: Grandpa's firm handshake somehow doubles as a short wrist-wrestling match.
examples.zh: 外公的「握手」兼具掰手腕功能。

words.enDefinition: weighing a lot; hard to lift or carry

examples.en: The crate is heavy enough that two cousins argue over pushing or pulling.
examples.zh: 箱子「重」得两个表亲争论该推还是该拉。

examples.en: Grandpa says a heavy basket builds better shoulders than any gym.
examples.zh: 外公说拎重篮子比健身房更练「肩膀力气」。

words.enDefinition: the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists

examples.en: The local paper interviewed our stall about the loquat shortage.
examples.zh: 本地报纸来「采访」我们的摊位，问枇杷短缺的事。

examples.en: Grandpa calmly treated the scholarship interview like a chess opening.
examples.zh: 外公把奖学金「面谈」当成象棋开局来对待。

words.enDefinition: (usually plural) a polite expression of desire for someone's welfare

examples.en: Give my regards to your parents when the peaches arrive.
examples.zh: 桃子到的时候，代我向你父母「问好」。

examples.en: The postcard closed with kind regards and one drawing of a duck.
examples.zh: 明信片结尾写着诚挚的「问候」，还画了一只鸭子。

words.enDefinition: seat for one person, with a support for the back

examples.en: Grandpa repaired the wobbly chair just before the chess match.
examples.zh: 象棋开赛前，外公把摇晃的「椅子」修好了。

examples.en: The chair by the window is reserved for the market cat.
examples.zh: 窗边那把「椅子」是留给市场那只猫的。

words.enDefinition: person engaged in one of the learned professions

examples.en: As the only trained professional in the lane, Auntie Mei sees patients free.
examples.zh: 作为巷里唯一的持证「专业人士」，梅姨看诊分文不取。

examples.en: Hire a real professional to rewire the stall before summer.
examples.zh: 入夏前请「专业」人员来给摊位重新布线。

words.enDefinition: day on which work is suspended by law or custom

examples.en: The whole lane takes a holiday on the day the loquats ripen.
examples.zh: 枇杷熟的那天，全巷子都当「节日」过。

examples.en: Grandpa's idea of a holiday is two stools and one river.
examples.zh: 外公的理想「假日」是两张凳子加一条河。

words.enDefinition: equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)

examples.en: Grandpa's old camera survives dust, heavy rain, and curious toddlers.
examples.zh: 外公的「相机」扛得住灰尘、雨水和好奇的幼儿。

examples.en: The kind market photographer fixed my camera strap for free.
examples.zh: 市场的照相师傅免费修好了我的「相机」背带。

words.enDefinition: social relations involving intrigue to gain authority or power

examples.en: Grandpa follows local county politics the way others follow football.
examples.zh: 外公追踪县里「政治」的热情，不亚于别人追球赛。

examples.en: Office politics reached the chess table and lost to checkmate.
examples.zh: 办公室「权斗」蔓延到了棋桌，结果被将死。

words.enDefinition: carry out or perform an action

examples.en: The surgeon will perform the operation early on Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 外科医生定于周二上午「做」这台手术。

examples.en: Grandpa performs the annual lantern-lighting with more ceremony than skill.
examples.zh: 外公「执行」点灯仪式，排场远大于手艺。

words.enDefinition: an interpretation of a matter from a particular viewpoint

examples.en: The app's new version finally sorts nearby stalls by distance.
examples.zh: 应用的新「版本」终于能按距离给摊位排序了。

examples.en: Grandpa's version of the famous fish story grows each retelling.
examples.zh: 每讲一次，外公那个钓鱼故事的「版本」就更大一号。

words.enDefinition: the vertical force exerted by a mass as a result of gravity

examples.en: Always check the parcel's weight before the post office does.
examples.zh: 邮局称重之前，自己先核对包裹「重量」。

examples.en: Grandpa judges melons by weight, sound, and one confident slap.
examples.zh: 外公挑瓜靠「重量」、听声，外加自信的一拍。

words.enDefinition: someone who is considered for something (for an office or prize or honor etc.)

examples.en: Every candidate for lantern queen must carry her own ladder.
examples.zh: 灯会皇后每位「候选人」都得自己扛梯子。

examples.en: The stall rented to the youngest candidate for half price.
examples.zh: 摊位以半价租给了最年轻的「竞选者」。

words.enDefinition: the region that is inside of something

examples.en: Grandma hides her good vinegar inside the big rice jar.
examples.zh: 外婆把好醋藏在米缸「里面」。

examples.en: The cat watches the goldfish from inside the umbrella stand.
examples.zh: 猫从伞架「里面」盯着金鱼看。

words.enDefinition: the quality of having a superior or more favorable position

examples.en: The corner stall's advantage is shade from two o'clock onward.
examples.zh: 街角摊位的「优势」是下午两点起有阴凉。

examples.en: Grandpa's height is no advantage when the awning is low.
examples.zh: 雨棚低矮时，外公的身高可算不上「优势」。

words.enDefinition: fully developed person from maturity onward

examples.en: Every adult in the lane has bought Grandma's pickles at least once.
examples.zh: 巷子里每一位「成年人」至少买过一次外婆的腌菜。

examples.en: Grandpa became an adult, in his own telling, at nine.
examples.zh: 照他自己讲，外公九岁就算「成年」了。

words.enDefinition: strong feeling of anxiety

examples.en: Money worries kept Grandpa awake at night until the fishing improved.
examples.zh: 鱼情好转之前，「钱」的忧虑让外公夜不能寐。

examples.en: Grandma's one worry is the cat meeting the market dog.
examples.zh: 外婆唯一的「担心」是猫撞上市场那只狗。

words.enDefinition: the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary

examples.en: Wipe the table's surface before the health inspector's flashlight does.
examples.zh: 趁卫生检查员的手电筒没照到，先擦净桌面「表面」。

examples.en: The pond's surface reflects the lanterns until the carp leap.
examples.zh: 鲤鱼跃起之前，「水面」一直映着灯笼。

words.enDefinition: without delay or hesitation; with no time intervening

examples.en: Please call me immediately if the ferry tickets sell out.
examples.zh: 船票一售罄，请「立即」打给我。

examples.en: Grandpa responded immediately when the cat coughed up the key.
examples.zh: 猫把钥匙咳出来，外公「马上」就做出了反应。

words.enDefinition: an indefinite quantity of something having a specified value

examples.en: Two yuan's worth of peanuts keeps the chess table honest.
examples.zh: 两块钱的「等值」花生能让棋桌风平浪静。

examples.en: Grandpa estimates a stall's worth by how long the queue argues.
examples.zh: 外公靠队伍吵嚷的时长来估算「价值」。

words.enDefinition: source of difficulty

examples.en: The leaking awning caused trouble for every stall below it.
examples.zh: 漏雨的雨棚给楼下每个摊位都「添了麻烦」。

examples.en: Grandpa went to the trouble of labelling every pickle jar twice.
examples.zh: 外公不嫌「麻烦」，把每个腌菜罐都贴了两遍标签。

words.enDefinition: land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water

examples.en: The little island's ferry runs only twice daily, weather permitting.
examples.zh: 天气允许时，「岛」上的渡轮每天两班。

examples.en: Grandpa vacationed on the island and returned with forty fish stories.
examples.zh: 外公去「岛」上度假，带回来四十个钓鱼故事。

words.enDefinition: demanding or stimulating situation

examples.en: The proper dumpling-fold is a challenge Grandma sets all newcomers.
examples.zh: 包出合格饺子是外婆给新手的「挑战」。

examples.en: Carrying the lantern pole uphill was the day's real challenge.
examples.zh: 扛灯杆上山才是当天真正的「考验」。

words.enDefinition: the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm

examples.en: Grandpa's strong shoulder knows exactly where the market cart fits.
examples.zh: 外公的「肩膀」清楚知道推车该顶在哪个位置。

examples.en: The kid fell asleep on Grandma's shoulder before the second stall.
examples.zh: 还没逛到第二个摊位，孩子就在外婆「肩头」睡着了。

words.enDefinition: be contingent upon (something that is elided)

examples.en: Whether we actually camp depends entirely on the tent's mood.
examples.zh: 是否露营完全「取决于」帐篷的心情。

examples.en: Grandpa says good dumplings depend on cold hands and warm dough.
examples.zh: 外公说好饺子「靠」的是手凉面温。

words.enDefinition: the property resulting from being or relating to the greater in number of two parts; the main part

examples.en: The majority of the lane voted for a second lantern night.
examples.zh: 巷子里「大多数」人投票赞成再加一晚灯会。

examples.en: Grandpa claims the majority of his fish stories are true.
examples.zh: 外公声称他的钓鱼故事「大多数」是真的。

words.enDefinition: series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep

examples.en: My vivid dream about flying ended when the alarm rang.
examples.zh: 梦见飞翔的「美梦」被闹钟掐断了。

examples.en: Grandpa's dream is a stall by the sea and a lazy cat.
examples.zh: 外公的「梦想」是海边的摊位加一只懒猫。

words.enDefinition: delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration

examples.en: The calligraphy on the shop sign is beautiful in any weather.
examples.zh: 店招上的书法无论什么天气看都很「美」。

examples.en: Grandma looked beautiful in her new festival scarf, everyone agreed.
examples.zh: 大家都说，外婆戴上新的节日围巾「真好看」。

words.enDefinition: legislative assembly in certain countries

examples.en: The parliament debated the market roof for two rainy evenings.
examples.zh: 「议会」就市场顶棚辩了两个雨夜。

examples.en: Tourists watch the parliament building only when the guards change.
examples.zh: 游客们只在换岗时才看「国会」大厦。

words.enDefinition: in place of, or as an alternative to

examples.en: The bus was full, so we took the ferry instead.
examples.zh: 公交满了，我们「改乘」了渡轮。

examples.en: Grandpa wanted tea; he got fish soup instead and liked it.
examples.zh: 外公本想喝茶，结果上来的是鱼汤，他「反倒」喜欢。

words.enDefinition: miscellaneous unspecified objects

examples.en: Whose stuff is this on the stairs — the noodles or the broom?
examples.zh: 楼梯上这些「东西」是谁的——面条还是扫帚？

examples.en: Grandpa's fishing stuff now fills half the storage room downstairs.
examples.zh: 外公的钓鱼「家什」如今占了储藏室半间。

words.enDefinition: periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it

examples.en: The travel magazine interviewed our lane about the loquat festival.
examples.zh: 杂志就枇杷节「采访」了我们巷子。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps every magazine that ever printed his weather rhymes.
examples.zh: 凡登过他天气谚语的「杂志」，外公都留着。

words.enDefinition: an enlisted man or woman who serves in an army

examples.en: The old soldier still folds his quilt into a perfect square.
examples.zh: 这位老「兵」叠的被子依然方方正正。

examples.en: Grandpa's uncle was a soldier who traded stories for dumplings.
examples.zh: 外公的叔叔当过「军人」，用故事换饺子吃。

words.enDefinition: producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect

examples.en: The fan is effective only if you point it at the dumplings.
examples.zh: 电扇只有对着饺子吹才「有效」。

examples.en: Grandpa found the old vinegar cure surprisingly effective on mosquitoes.
examples.zh: 外公发现醋疗法治蚊子咬「出奇地有效」。

words.enDefinition: the opening through which food is taken in and vocalizations emerge

examples.en: The baby's whole little mouth turned jam-purple at breakfast today.
examples.zh: 早餐时宝宝的整张「嘴」都染成了果酱紫。

examples.en: Grandpa says the mouth that tastes the soup cooks the best soup.
examples.zh: 外公说，会「尝」汤的嘴才能煲出最好的汤。

words.enDefinition: a rough, aggressive person; a person who uses threats

examples.en: The film's tough kicked the door in and apologized for the splinters.
examples.zh: 片中那个「恶棍」踹门而入，还为木屑道了歉。

examples.en: Grandpa looks like a tough but feeds every stray in the lane.
examples.zh: 外公看着像个「凶汉」，却喂遍了巷里的流浪猫。

words.enDefinition: building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry

examples.en: The riverside park's barbecue facility books out every holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 公园的烧烤「设施」每个节假日周末都被订满。

examples.en: The gym's basement shower facility reopens after the pipe repair.
examples.zh: 管道修好后，健身房的淋浴「设施」重新开放。

words.enDefinition: detailed critical inspection

examples.en: The council's noise survey measured sound outside every school gate.
examples.zh: 议会的「调查」测遍了每所学校门口的噪音。

examples.en: Grandpa joined the bird survey and reported forty species, plus one cat.
examples.zh: 外公参加鸟类「调查」，上报四十种鸟，外加一只猫。

words.enDefinition: make available; provide

examples.en: Grandpa personally extended a warm welcome to the new stallholders.
examples.zh: 外公向新摊主们「表示」热情欢迎。

examples.en: She extended her umbrella to the soaked student without a word.
examples.zh: 她一言不发地把伞「递给」了淋湿的学生。

words.enDefinition: having the leading position or higher score in a contest

examples.en: At halftime we were ahead by two goals and one lost shoe.
examples.zh: 中场时我们「领先」两球，还多占了一只鞋的便宜。

examples.en: Grandpa finishes the puzzle ahead of everyone by reading the box art.
examples.zh: 外公靠看盒面图案，「抢先」完成拼图。

words.enDefinition: the 3rd planet from the sun; the planet we live on

examples.en: The best dumplings on earth, according to Grandma, are ours.
examples.zh: 照外婆的说法，世上最好的饺子就是我们的，「无人能及」。

examples.en: Grandpa claims the river moves more earth than the diggers do.
examples.zh: 外公说这条河搬动的「土方」比挖掘机还多。

words.enDefinition: connected with buying and selling goods or services

examples.en: The commercial heart of our district is still the wet market.
examples.zh: 我们区的「商业」中心依然是那座菜市。

examples.en: Grandpa distrusts flashy commercial slogans and simply trusts his neighbours.
examples.zh: 外公不信「商业」口号，只信邻居。

words.enDefinition: tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow

examples.en: The shiny object on the stall turned out to be Grandma's old ladle.
examples.zh: 摊上那个发亮的「物件」原来是外婆的旧汤勺。

examples.en: Grandpa can identify any flying object by its shadow alone.
examples.zh: 外公单凭影子就能认出任何飞行「物体」。

words.enDefinition: the details of where a building or person is located, used for letters or visits

examples.en: Write your address on the crate or the courier invents one.
examples.zh: 把「地址」写在箱子上，不然快递员会替你编一个。

examples.en: Grandpa remembers your address, your birthday, and your dog's name.
examples.zh: 外公记得你的「住址」、生日，还有你狗的名字。

words.enDefinition: future prospect or potential

examples.en: There's a real possibility that the ferry stops running tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚渡轮停开的可能性「确实存在」。

examples.en: Grandpa sees the possibility of rain in one seagull's mood.
examples.zh: 外公从一只海鸥的心情里看出「下雨的可能」。

words.enDefinition: the state of being actual or real

examples.en: The reality of night-market work is cold hands and warm customers.
examples.zh: 夜市工作的「现实」是手冷、客人暖。

examples.en: Grandpa quietly accepted the reality that the cat outranks him.
examples.zh: 外公接受了猫地位比他高的「现实」。

words.enDefinition: (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team

examples.en: Our swim coach starts the whistle before the water settles.
examples.zh: 我们的游泳「教练」在水还没平静时就吹哨了。

examples.en: Grandpa volunteers every Saturday as coach for the lane's chess beginners.
examples.zh: 外公自愿给巷里的象棋新手当「教练」。

words.enDefinition: an announcement containing information about an event

examples.en: A notice about the lift repair is pinned beside the letterboxes.
examples.zh: 电梯维修的「通知」钉在信箱旁边。

examples.en: We posted a notice about the lost cat; the cat ignored it.
examples.zh: 我们贴了寻猫「启事」；猫本猫毫无反应。

words.enDefinition: an act of aggression (as one against a person who resists)

examples.en: The war film shows the aftermath, never the violence itself.
examples.zh: 影片只拍事发之后，从不正面表现「暴力」。

examples.en: Grandpa swapped old war stories quietly, skipping the violence entirely.
examples.zh: 外公轻声讲着战争往事，「暴力」的部分略过不提。

words.enDefinition: large or relatively large in number or amount or extent or degree

examples.en: The spring renovations caused considerable dust and one happy lizard.
examples.zh: 装修带来「相当多」的灰尘和一只快乐的蜥蜴。

examples.en: Grandpa saved a considerable sum by mending the cart himself.
examples.zh: 外公自己修好了推车，省下「可观」的一笔钱。

words.enDefinition: any of the terminal members of the hand (sometimes excepting the thumb)

examples.en: Grandma counts change on her fingers faster than any machine.
examples.zh: 外婆掰着「手指」数钱，比任何机器都快。

examples.en: Keep your fingers away from the dumpling press; ask the cat why.
examples.zh: 别把「手指」伸进压饺子机——想知道为什么，去问那只猫。

words.enDefinition: an amount of something available for use

examples.en: The village water supply returns on Tuesdays, at least officially.
examples.zh: 官方说法是「供水」每周二恢复。

examples.en: Grandpa stocks a three-day supply of candles before every typhoon.
examples.zh: 台风前，外公备好三天用的蜡烛「储备」。

words.enDefinition: person who is a member of a partnership

examples.en: My dance partner counts steps out loud, which helps nobody.
examples.zh: 我的舞「伴」大声数拍子，对谁都无济于事。

examples.en: Grandpa's only business partner is the cat, on profit-sharing terms.
examples.zh: 外公的生意「合伙人」是那只猫，利润分成制。

words.enDefinition: observe, check out, and look over carefully or inspect

examples.en: The doctor examined Grandpa's sore knee and prescribed stairs, slowly.
examples.zh: 医生「检查」了外公的膝盖，开的处方是爬楼梯，慢慢爬。

examples.en: The friendly customs officer examined every lantern in the van.
examples.zh: 海关人员「查验」了车里的每一盏灯笼。

words.enDefinition: applying to ordinary citizens as contrasted with the military

examples.en: They married in a small civil ceremony at the county office.
examples.zh: 他们在县政务厅办了个简单的「民政」婚礼。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps civil and lets the queue argue itself out.
examples.zh: 外公保持「心平气和」，让队伍自己吵完。

words.enDefinition: writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)

examples.en: Sign the official document twice; the clerk likes spare signatures.
examples.zh: 「文件」签两次，办事员喜欢备用签名。

examples.en: Grandpa's safest document is the pickle recipe, kept in three places.
examples.zh: 外公保存最严实的「文件」是腌菜配方，一式三份。

words.enDefinition: worthy of or requiring responsibility or trust; or held accountable

examples.en: The duty rota is fair because everyone is responsible for one evening.
examples.zh: 排班表很公平，「每个人」都负责一个晚上。

examples.en: Grandpa feels responsible for the lane's stray cats, all nine.
examples.zh: 巷里的九只流浪猫，外公都觉得「归他管」。

words.enDefinition: power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc

examples.en: Grandma's quiet influence settled the whole chair dispute in one sentence.
examples.zh: 外婆一句话的「影响力」化解了椅子之争。

examples.en: The late radio host's influence doubled our stall's Saturday queue.
examples.zh: 电台主持人的「号召力」让我们周六的队伍翻倍。

words.enDefinition: an unfortunate person who suffers from some adverse circumstance

examples.en: The uninsured corner stallholder was by far the fire's biggest victim.
examples.zh: 没买保险的摊主是那场火灾最大的「受害者」。

examples.en: Grandpa, victim of a thousand umbrella thefts, now chains his to the bench.
examples.zh: 吃过上千次雨伞被偷亏的外公，如今把伞锁在长椅上「以防万一」。

words.enDefinition: daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements

examples.en: The newspaper delivery reaches the lane before the cats wake.
examples.zh: 「报纸」送抵巷子的时间比猫醒来还早。

examples.en: Grandpa reads the newspaper aloud to whoever shares his bench.
examples.zh: 外公把「报纸」读给任何同坐一条凳的人听。

words.enDefinition: written form of a musical composition; parts for different instruments appear on separate staves on large pages

examples.en: The conductor's score is annotated with tea stains and shortcuts.
examples.zh: 指挥的「总谱」上标着茶渍和捷径。

examples.en: Grandpa once read the orchestral score like a bus timetable.
examples.zh: 外公把管弦乐「谱」读得像公交时刻表一样溜。

words.enDefinition: the occurrence of a change for the worse

examples.en: The storm's damage to the awnings cost three stalls their week.
examples.zh: 风暴对雨棚的「破坏」让三个摊位损失了一周生意。

examples.en: Grandpa assessed the water damage with one sock and much sighing.
examples.zh: 外公穿着一只袜子「勘查」了水患，叹了很多气。

words.enDefinition: gathering of spectators or listeners at a (usually public) performance

examples.en: The street magician's small audience included two deeply skeptical grandmothers.
examples.zh: 魔术师的「观众」里有两位将信将疑的奶奶。

examples.en: Half the audience left when the lanterns dimmed; the dumplings won.
examples.zh: 灯笼一暗，「观众」走了一半；最后是饺子赢了。

words.enDefinition: the day after today

examples.en: Tomorrow the market moves two streets north for the festival.
examples.zh: 「明天」市场为节庆搬到北边两条街外。

examples.en: Grandpa says tomorrow's weather secretly lives in today's sunset colours.
examples.zh: 外公说「明天」的天气就藏在今天的晚霞里。

words.enDefinition: the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday

examples.en: Dinner at Grandma's table runs four courses and three arguments.
examples.zh: 在外婆家吃「晚饭」是四道菜加三场争论。

examples.en: The whole lane shares one long dinner table at festival time.
examples.zh: 节庆时，全巷子共用一张长长的「晚宴」桌。

words.enDefinition: an additional edition of a newspaper (usually to report a crisis)

examples.en: The newsboy waved an extra above his head at half past five.
examples.zh: 五点半，报童头顶挥舞着一份「号外」。

examples.en: Grandpa kept the extra from the day the bridge opened.
examples.zh: 大桥通车那天的「号外」，外公一直留着。

words.enDefinition: the act of going from one place to another

examples.en: Air travel to the coast beats the twelve-hour bus, mostly.
examples.zh: 去海边的「航空出行」大多胜过十二小时大巴。

examples.en: Grandpa's travel plans always include one noodle detour on the way home.
examples.zh: 外公的「旅行」计划里总有一段为吃面绕的回头路。

words.enDefinition: the formal presentation of a stated proposition and the opposition to it (usually followed by a vote)

examples.en: The roof debate ended when Grandma brought out actual rain samples.
examples.zh: 外婆端出真雨水的样本后，顶棚「辩论」就此收场。

examples.en: Grandpa joined the parking debate on both sides, on two evenings.
examples.zh: 外公两个晚上分别站在「辩论」双方，两边都参加了。

words.enDefinition: native or naturalized member of a state or other political community

examples.en: New citizens took the oath at the county hall on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，新「公民」在县政务大厅宣誓。

examples.en: As a citizen, Grandpa treats voting as a dumpling-day outing.
examples.zh: 作为「公民」，外公把投票当成赶集一样的出游。

words.enDefinition: district of a city having some distinguishing character

examples.en: The old quarter floods its lanes with lanterns every New Year.
examples.zh: 每年新年，老「城区」的大街小巷都挂满灯笼。

examples.en: We wandered the artisan quarter until the shoe seller fed us tea.
examples.zh: 我们在手艺人「街区」逛到鞋匠请我们喝茶。

words.enDefinition: after an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay

examples.en: Eventually the slow ferry arrived, along with our lost hat.
examples.zh: 「最终」渡轮来了，还捎回了我们丢的帽子。

examples.en: The queue shortened eventually, after two staff and one miracle.
examples.zh: 两位员工加一个奇迹之后，队伍「终于」变短了。

words.enDefinition: to a high degree or extent; favorably or with much respect

examples.en: Grandpa rates the noodle stall highly and the queue honestly.
examples.zh: 外公对这家面馆「评价很高」，对队伍长度也很诚实。

examples.en: The judges thought highly of the smallest lantern this year.
examples.zh: 评委们对今年最小的灯笼「评价甚高」。

words.enDefinition: reference point to shoot at

examples.en: Our sales target this spring is one thousand pickle jars.
examples.zh: 我们春季的销售「目标」是一千罐腌菜。

examples.en: Grandpa hit the archery target once and guards that memory fiercely.
examples.zh: 外公射中过一次箭「靶」，把这段记忆守得死紧。

words.enDefinition: isolated from others

examples.en: Grandpa fishes alone but companionably feeds every patient heron nearby.
examples.zh: 外公「独自」钓鱼，却慷慨地喂着每一只苍鹭。

examples.en: The stall looks different when it is alone at closing time.
examples.zh: 打烊后摊位「独自」留在原地，看着不太一样。

words.enDefinition: be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.

examples.en: We attend the yearly lantern judging even without an entry.
examples.zh: 就算没作品，我们也会「出席」灯会评审。

examples.en: Grandpa attends the ferry on time better than the ferry itself.
examples.zh: 外公赴船「准时」得比渡轮还靠谱。

words.enDefinition: place off to the side of an area

examples.en: The fruit seller occupies the same corner as her mother did.
examples.zh: 水果摊贩占的「街角」和她母亲当年一模一样。

examples.en: Grandpa rounds every corner slowly, out of respect for cats.
examples.zh: 外公每个「拐角」都慢行，出于对猫的尊重。

words.enDefinition: a person from the south of a country or region

examples.en: As a lifelong southern, she measures rice by feel and sun by smell.
examples.zh: 作为土生土长的「南方人」，她凭手感量米、凭气味测太阳。

examples.en: The market's only southern sold winter coats to retirees, badly.
examples.zh: 市场里唯一的「南方人」向退休老人推销冬衣，卖得不好。

words.enDefinition: recently made, produced, or harvested

examples.en: Fresh coriander from the morning market makes the soup sing.
examples.zh: 早市现摘的「新鲜」香菜让汤活了起来。

examples.en: Grandpa calls river fish fresh only if it flops twice.
examples.zh: 外公只承认扑腾两下的河鱼才算「鲜」。

words.enDefinition: the visible part of a television transmission

examples.en: She filmed a video of the dumpling fold for the cousins.
examples.zh: 她拍了一段包饺子的「视频」发给表亲们。

examples.en: Grandpa's first video call lasted forty minutes on one camera angle.
examples.zh: 外公的首次「视频」通话四十分钟没换过机位。

words.enDefinition: to a small degree or extent

examples.en: The soup improved slightly after Grandma admitted the salt mishap.
examples.zh: 外婆承认盐放错后，汤「略微」好转了些。

examples.en: Grandpa walks slightly slower whenever the chess table is outdoors.
examples.zh: 棋桌摆到户外时，外公走路就会「稍慢」一点。

words.enDefinition: change for the better as a result of correcting abuses

examples.en: The famous market reform all started with one honest scale.
examples.zh: 市场的「改革」从一杆诚实的秤开始。

examples.en: Grandpa remembers the rent reform of 1998 like a wedding.
examples.zh: 1998 年的租金「改革」，外公记得像自家婚礼一样清楚。

words.enDefinition: building where people go to eat

examples.en: The new restaurant seats twelve and serves one perfect soup.
examples.zh: 新开的「餐馆」只设十二座，只卖一款完美的汤。

examples.en: We found the little dumpling restaurant by following the steam.
examples.zh: 我们循着蒸汽找到了那家饺子「馆」。

words.enDefinition: an ordered reference standard

examples.en: Nurses at the clinic rate pain on a scale from one to ten.
examples.zh: 诊所护士用一到十的「量表」评估疼痛。

examples.en: Grandpa judges dumplings on his own scale: skins intact or not.
examples.zh: 外公给饺子打分用他自己的「标度」：皮破不破。

words.enDefinition: public official authorized to decide questions brought before a court of justice

examples.en: The judge adjourned early for the loquat festival, everyone understood.
examples.zh: 「法官」为枇杷节提前休庭，众人都能理解。

examples.en: The talent-show judge gave full marks to the parrot recital.
examples.zh: 才艺比赛的「评委」给鹦鹉朗诵打了满分。

words.enDefinition: the part of the day between noon and evening

examples.en: The whole market sleeps every afternoon between two and four.
examples.zh: 市场每天「下午」两点到四点都会打盹。

examples.en: Grandpa naps every afternoon, his chair angled toward the river.
examples.zh: 外公每天「午后」都打盹，椅子朝着河的方向。

words.enDefinition: an essay or article that gives a critical evaluation (as of a book or play)

examples.en: The film got a glowing review in the county paper.
examples.zh: 县报给了那部影片一篇热情的「影评」。

examples.en: Grandpa writes a food review of every stall he queues at.
examples.zh: 外公给排过队的每个摊位都写「食评」。

words.enDefinition: request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)

examples.en: The kettle maker announced a recall of every model sold since March.
examples.zh: 水壶厂商宣布「召回」三月以来售出的全部型号。

examples.en: Our kettle is part of the recall; the cat looks relieved.
examples.zh: 我们家的水壶在「召回」范围内；猫看起来松了口气。

words.enDefinition: the state of being certain that adverse effects will not be caused by some agent under defined conditions

examples.en: The safety netting went up before the first crate climbed.
examples.zh: 第一箱货爬楼之前，安全「防护网」就装好了。

examples.en: Grandpa checks the fryer's safety valve like a temple ritual.
examples.zh: 外公检查油炸锅的安全「阀」，郑重得像庙里上香。

words.enDefinition: if not; in a different way or under other circumstances

examples.en: Leave now; otherwise we'll watch the ferry leave without us.
examples.zh: 现在就走，「否则」我们就只能目送渡轮了。

examples.en: The stall takes cash; otherwise it's the ATM two lanes over.
examples.zh: 摊位收现金，「不然」就得去隔两条巷的取款机。

words.enDefinition: in or to a place that is lower

examples.en: The cat sleeps below the stall, where dropped dumplings land.
examples.zh: 猫睡在摊位「下面」，正好接住掉落的饺子。

examples.en: Grandpa keeps the spare scales below the counter, out of reach.
examples.zh: 外公把备用秤放在柜台「底下」，猫够不着。

words.enDefinition: the relative position or standing of things or especially persons in a society

examples.en: The award raised the small clinic's status across two counties.
examples.zh: 那次获奖提升了诊所在两县的「声望」。

examples.en: Grandpa's status at the chess table survived his lost queen.
examples.zh: 外公在棋桌上的「地位」经受住了丢后一劫。

words.enDefinition: pair of parallel rails providing a runway for wheels

examples.en: Cyclists warm up on the track behind the old station.
examples.zh: 骑手们在老车站后的「跑道」上热身。

examples.en: Weeds grow between the track sleepers, silver in the dusk.
examples.zh: 「铁轨」枕木之间长出杂草，暮色里泛银。

words.enDefinition: group's refusal to work in protest against low pay or bad work conditions

examples.en: The dockworkers' strike paused the fish market for one foggy week.
examples.zh: 码头工人的「罢工」让鱼市停摆了一个多雾的星期。

examples.en: Grandpa crossed the strike line only to deliver noodles to both sides.
examples.zh: 外公跨过「罢工」警戒线，只为给双方送面。

words.enDefinition: an act that fails

examples.en: The sudden power failure hit during the lantern judging, twice.
examples.zh: 灯会评审期间「停电」了，而且不止一次。

examples.en: Grandpa kindly calls the cat's hunting failure a charity programme.
examples.zh: 外公把猫捕猎失败的「事迹」称为慈善项目。

words.enDefinition: the condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints

examples.en: Retirement finally gave Grandpa the freedom to nap at noon.
examples.zh: 退休给了外公中午打盹的「自由」。

examples.en: The lane's cats enjoy freedom of the market, all stalls included.
examples.zh: 巷里的猫享有市场「通行自由」，摊摊皆可。

words.enDefinition: person who enjoys reading

examples.en: My aunt is a slow reader and a fast gossip.
examples.zh: 姨妈是个「读书」慢、传话快的人。

examples.en: Grandpa, a lifelong newspaper reader, still folds pages into hats.
examples.zh: 外公读了一辈子「报」，至今还会把报纸叠成帽子。

words.enDefinition: completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers

examples.en: Absolutely nobody in their right mind queues behind Grandpa's chess debates.
examples.zh: 外公的棋局辩论「绝对」没人愿意排在后面。

examples.en: The dumplings were absolutely the best decision of the night.
examples.zh: 吃饺子「绝对」是当晚最正确的决定。

words.enDefinition: (mathematics) an unbounded two-dimensional shape

examples.en: Geometry class taught us that a plane has no edges at all.
examples.zh: 几何课告诉我们，「平面」根本没有边缘。

examples.en: Grandpa drew the stall layout on a single flat plane of paper.
examples.zh: 外公在一张「平面」纸上画出了摊位布局。

words.enDefinition: person of no influence

examples.en: Before the talent show, the magician was a complete nobody.
examples.zh: 才艺表演前，魔术师还是个无名「小卒」。

examples.en: Grandpa insists every nobody at the market knows his name.
examples.zh: 外公坚称市场里每个「无名之辈」都认识他。

words.enDefinition: something that is necessary or most important

examples.en: Sunscreen is a beach essential, and so is Grandma's pickle jar.
examples.zh: 防晒霜是海滩「必备品」，外婆的腌菜罐也是。

examples.en: Pack light: one good towel is the true travel essential.
examples.zh: 轻装上路：一条毛巾才是旅行真正的「必需品」。

words.enDefinition: the perfect tense of a verb in grammar

examples.en: The exam tested the present perfect until we dreamt in it.
examples.zh: 考试把现在「完成时」考到我们做梦都在用。

examples.en: Grandpa patiently learned the perfect tense to write better postcards.
examples.zh: 外公学「完成时」是为了把明信片写得更好。

words.enDefinition: something (as property) held by one party (the trustee) for the benefit of another (the beneficiary)

examples.en: Grandma put the riverside cottage in a trust for the cousins.
examples.zh: 外婆把河边的老屋放进了「信托」，留给表亲们。

examples.en: The small family trust pays the stall's rent every quarter.
examples.zh: 家族「信托」每季度支付摊位租金。

words.enDefinition: the way a person behaves, especially in public

examples.en: The school praised her calm conduct during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 学校表扬了她在消防演习中的「表现」。

examples.en: Grandpa's conduct at the mall buffets is a lane legend.
examples.zh: 外公在自助餐上的「举止」是本巷传奇。

words.enDefinition: the event of something coming in contact with the body

examples.en: Even a light touch leaves marks on the fresh paint.
examples.zh: 在未干的漆面上，轻轻一「碰」也会留痕。

examples.en: Grandpa judged the noodle dough by touch alone, eyes shut.
examples.zh: 外公闭着眼，单凭「触摸」就判断出面团的劲道。

words.enDefinition: string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language

examples.en: Write one sentence per stall and pass the notebook on.
examples.zh: 每个摊位写一句「话」，然后把笔记传下去。

examples.en: The topic sentence of Grandpa's letters is always the weather.
examples.zh: 外公书信的「主题句」永远是天气。

words.enDefinition: natural and periodic state of rest during which consciousness of the world is suspended

examples.en: Grandpa's long afternoon sleep easily outlasts two full radio dramas.
examples.zh: 外公的午后「睡眠」能跨越两集广播剧。

examples.en: The cat's sleep schedule conflicts with the market's schedule, daily.
examples.zh: 那只猫的「睡眠」时间每天和市场营业时间冲突。

words.enDefinition: easily perceived by the senses or grasped by the mind

examples.en: It was obvious the cat had been in the flour bag again.
examples.zh: 「很明显」那只猫又进过面粉袋。

examples.en: Grandpa finds it obvious that rain follows the festival calendar.
examples.zh: 外公觉得雨「显然」跟着节庆日历来。

words.enDefinition: the linear extent in space from one end to the other; the longest dimension of something that is fixed in place

examples.en: The queue's whole length doubles whenever the school bell rings.
examples.zh: 放学铃一响，队伍的「长度」就翻倍。

examples.en: Grandpa measures rope by arm spans, never by actual length.
examples.zh: 外公量绳子全靠臂展，从不用实际「长度」。

words.enDefinition: state of equilibrium

examples.en: Grandpa somehow keeps his life balanced between chess and fishing.
examples.zh: 外公把下棋和钓鱼「平衡」得很好。

examples.en: The stall's weekly accounts finally balance after the scale repair.
examples.zh: 秤修好后，摊位的账终于「收支相抵」。

words.enDefinition: an open clash between two opposing groups (or individuals)

examples.en: The timetable conflict eventually moved the chess club to Thursdays.
examples.zh: 日程「冲突」让象棋社改到了周四。

examples.en: Grandpa mediates every little market conflict with tea and patience.
examples.zh: 外公用茶和耐心调解市场上的每一场「争执」。

words.enDefinition: the vital principle or animating force within living things

examples.en: The stall's team spirit survives even a completely sold-out morning.
examples.zh: 就算清早售罄，摊位的团队「士气」也不倒。

examples.en: Grandpa has the spirit of a man who naps without guilt.
examples.zh: 外公浑身是那种午睡毫无负罪感的「精神头」。

words.enDefinition: an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members

examples.en: Our small village side finally topped the weekend football league.
examples.zh: 我们村队终于在周末足球「联赛」登顶。

examples.en: The village chess league meets above the old teahouse, Wednesdays.
examples.zh: 象棋「联盟」每周三在茶馆楼上赛。

words.enDefinition: the state of being unsure of something

examples.en: I have no doubt the cat ate the order slip.
examples.zh: 我毫不「怀疑」是猫吃了点单小票。

examples.en: Grandpa doubts the weather app more than the sparrows do.
examples.zh: 外公对天气应用的「怀疑」比麻雀还多。

words.enDefinition: public transport provided by a line of railway cars coupled together and drawn by a locomotive

examples.en: The slow train leaves at six and takes every hilly view.
examples.zh: 慢「车」六点发车，沿途山景一个不落。

examples.en: Grandpa waves at the freight train like an old friend.
examples.zh: 外公对着货运「火车」挥手，像见老朋友。

words.enDefinition: that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord

examples.en: Grandpa claims his brain works best two dumplings after lunch.
examples.zh: 外公声称自己的「脑子」在午饭后两个饺子时最灵光。

examples.en: The chess brain of our lane lives above the fruit stall.
examples.zh: 本巷的象棋「大脑」住在水果摊楼上。

words.enDefinition: workplace for the teaching or practice of an art

examples.en: The pottery studio above the bakery smells of clay and sugar.
examples.zh: 面包店楼上的陶艺「工作室」弥漫着陶土和糖香。

examples.en: Grandpa's radio studio is one stool and a cupped hand.
examples.zh: 外公的广播「工作室」就是一条凳加一只拢起的手。

words.enDefinition: time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday

examples.en: The weekend market spills into the car park by eight.
examples.zh: 一到「周末」，市场八点就漫到停车场去了。

examples.en: Grandpa guards his precious weekend nap like a bank vault.
examples.zh: 外公守卫「周末」午睡如守银行金库。

words.enDefinition: the cardinal number that is the sum of eleven and one

examples.en: Grandma buys eggs by the dozen and never counts the last one.
examples.zh: 外婆按「打」买鸡蛋，从来不数最后一枚。

examples.en: A dozen hungry cousins claimed the loquat tree before breakfast.
examples.zh: 早饭前，十二个「一打」表亲占领了枇杷树。

words.enDefinition: close interaction

examples.en: Grandpa keeps contact with every ferry captain by whistle code.
examples.zh: 外公靠口哨暗号与每位渡轮船长保持「联系」。

examples.en: Avoid eye contact with the queue-jumper; the aunties handle it.
examples.zh: 别与插队者有「目光接触」；阿姨们会处理的。

words.enDefinition: hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war

examples.en: Grandpa re-fights the battle of the flooded stall every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天，外公都要重新「复盘」摊位被淹那场「战役」。

examples.en: The great snowball battle across the lane lasted until dinner.
examples.zh: 横跨巷子的雪球「大战」一直打到晚饭。

words.enDefinition: any spatial attributes (especially as defined by outline)

examples.en: Each dumpling's final shape depends on which cousin folded it.
examples.zh: 饺子的「形状」取决于哪个表亲包的。

examples.en: Grandpa trims the hedge into a shape resembling a sleeping dog.
examples.zh: 外公把树篱修成一只睡狗的「造型」。

words.enDefinition: a system or means of carrying people or goods from place to place

examples.en: Public transport here means one old bus and many opinions.
examples.zh: 这里的公共「交通」就是一辆公交加众人议论。

examples.en: Grandma trusts the river transport more than the ring road.
examples.zh: 外婆信河上的「运输」，胜过信环城路。

words.enDefinition: depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value

examples.en: The county museum proudly displays Grandma's very first market scale.
examples.zh: 县「博物馆」展出了外婆的第一杆市场秤。

examples.en: We visited the museum during the rain and stayed for the model ships.
examples.zh: 下雨天我们逛了「博物馆」，还看了船模展。

words.enDefinition: a book or magazine published once a year; also an annual report in business contexts

examples.en: Her graduation photo made the college annual on page seven.
examples.zh: 她的毕业照登上了大学「年刊」第七页。

examples.en: The society's annual collects every lantern design made since 1990.
examples.zh: 协会的「年刊」收录了 1990 年以来所有的灯彩设计。

words.enDefinition: take in marriage

examples.en: They plan to marry in the courtyard, lanterns strictly optional.
examples.zh: 他们「打算」在院子里成婚，灯笼自选。

examples.en: Grandpa married his childhood neighbour from two stalls further down.
examples.zh: 外公「娶了」隔着两个摊位长大的邻家姑娘。

words.enDefinition: the state of being present; current existence

examples.en: The mayor's surprise presence instantly doubled the loquat festival crowd.
examples.zh: 镇长的「出席」让枇杷节人流翻倍。

examples.en: The cat insists on its presence at every inventory count.
examples.zh: 每次盘点，那只猫都坚持要「在场」。

words.enDefinition: the activity of protecting someone or something

examples.en: The new awning offers real protection from the April hail.
examples.zh: 雨棚在四月冰雹天里提供了实实在在的「保护」。

examples.en: Grandpa's sunscreen is the only sun protection he truly trusts.
examples.zh: 防晒霜是外公唯一信得过的「防护」。

words.enDefinition: to bring things together, or to pick someone or something up

examples.en: Grandpa collects fresh market gossip the way bees collect pollen.
examples.zh: 外公「收集」市场八卦，像蜜蜂采蜜一样勤快。

examples.en: I collect the younger cousins from the station every Friday.
examples.zh: 每周五我都去车站「接」表亲们。

words.enDefinition: the only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees and ants and termites; its function is to lay eggs

examples.en: The beekeeper showed us the queen through the glass frame.
examples.zh: 养蜂人隔着玻璃框给我们看了「蜂后」。

examples.en: A queen ant founded a colony under the market scale.
examples.zh: 一只蚁「后」在市场秤底下建立了一个王国。

words.enDefinition: directs the work of others

examples.en: The old dog obeys its master before the whistle finishes.
examples.zh: 口哨还没吹完，狗就听「主人」的了。

examples.en: As master of the workshop, Grandpa assigns the noisy jobs to himself.
examples.zh: 作为作坊的「主人」，外公把吵闹的活都派给了自己。

words.enDefinition: single serving of a beverage

examples.en: The only drink Grandpa truly trusts is tea, twice boiled.
examples.zh: 外公唯一信得过的「饮品」是煮过两遍的茶。

examples.en: One cold drink later, everyone in the queue forgave it.
examples.zh: 一杯冰「饮料」下肚，大家原谅了排队。

words.enDefinition: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit

examples.en: Grandpa cheerfully calls hauling heavy market crates his morning exercise.
